description: This source file defines structures, enums, and functions for managing device authentication tokens, stored in a JSON file. It provides functionality to load, store, clear, normalize, and persist device auth entries, encapsulated in a static enum.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a device authentication token for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores a device authentication token with associated device ID, role, scopes, and updates timestamp.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Clears (removes) a token for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Removes whitespace and newlines from the role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace from each scope, filters out empty scopes, and returns a sorted array of unique scopes.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL path to the JSON file storing device auth data.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the JSON data from file into a DeviceAuthStoreFile object.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes the store object into JSON and writes it to disk, creating directories as needed.
